summary: Phase 15 tested end-to-end: dispute reason exclusions (backend + Admin UI pill toggles) and Apify sync status endpoints. All 12 new backend tests pass (serial run) plus Phase 14 regression (11/11). UI verified: admin/settings shows exclusions block with 5 pill toggles, counterfeit excluded by default, toggling flips state, helper text updates, and Save persists to backend.
critical_code_review_comments: Global settings tests race under pytest-xdist (parallel workers). Recommend adding pytest marker or serializing settings-mutating suites (e.g., @pytest.mark.serial or configure loadscope by class). Currently ran with -n 0 to work around. Phase 14 & 15 both mutate the same global doc.
server.py is now 3009 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting (settings/disputes/apify routers) in a future refactor.
admin_update_settings does not validate numeric bounds on threshold (accepts negative floats). Minor — not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Phase 15 test creates TEST_ prefixed listings/categories via public API; buyer users e2e_p15_*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings are reset to threshold=0 and exclusions=['counterfeit'] after tests. When running Phase 14 + 15 together, use pytest -n 0 to avoid xdist race on the global settings doc. Apify status endpoints confirmed: source='junglee/amazon-crawler', total_listings numeric, started_at/last_sync_at populated. POST /api/admin/sync/apify returns ok:true with started or already_running.
